correctness.rationale: For a face of the ordinary open-neighborhood complex, the union of its three-subset vertices omits at least three labels. An invariant face is a union of triple-orbits; alternating orientation contribution equals (-1)^{number of selected orbits+1}. Boolean Möbius inversion over the label cycles gives exact-support contribution (-1)^{cycle_count}(1-a-b+binom(a,2)). Removing supports missing <=2 labels yields Q(a,b), and degree n-6 concentration by Nilakantan–Singh converts the reduced Lefschetz trace to the claimed character. The character-binomial basis has zero signed/unsigned average when n>=6, giving both quotients rational acyclicity. Independently implemented a distinct orbit-mask dynamic program over all 48 cycle-type cases for n=6..8, agreeing exactly. Finite checks do not prove the all-n assertion.
residual_risks: Finite checks are only corroboration; proof relies on stated unrestricted symbolic/collapsing argument.
